# Three.js r180 / 0.180.0

Vendored ES modules from the official tagged release:

- https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180/build
- https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r180/LICENSE

`three.module.min.js` imports the adjacent `three.core.min.js`. Both are unmodified.
MIT license: see `LICENSE`. Including these locally keeps gameplay independent of a CDN and requires no package installation or build step.
